subtitle: Look up a customer and export or erase their personal data on their behalf, for people who ask by email or phone. Every step is recorded in the audit log.
verifyFirst: Confirm the requester's identity first, by your own procedure. This screen cannot tell whether the person asking is who they say they are.
placeholder_external_id: The user id from your own system
referenceHint: Saved with the audit entry so the action can be traced back to the request.
truncated: More customers matched than are shown, or the phone search stopped early. Narrow the search.
maskedNote: Contact details are masked here. The export contains the full record.
exportError: Could not export this customer's data.
eraseError: Could not erase this customer's data.
eraseBody: Customer #{{id}} and their chat messages will be anonymised permanently. This cannot be undone.
eraseEffect1: Name, email, phone and external IDs are removed from the customer record.
eraseEffect2: Chat messages and attachments from their sessions are redacted or deleted.
eraseEffect3: The identity is remembered so a later sync cannot re-create it.
legalHold: Check for a legal hold or a pending regulator request before you continue.

error.E5115: Enter at least 3 characters to look up a customer.
error.E5116: No such customer in this tenant.
error.E5117: The confirmation does not match the customer id.
